purpose: Cover US-205 (engineer jumps to any document or AC by id): id-first ranking (exact / prefix / contains), word-match title above snippet, single-char ids-only, hash pick lands and expands the entity, mount URL round-trip, embed/theme preservation, empty-state on fetch failure, no outbound postMessage / storage / cookies. Points at the 22 new unit tests under test/view/id-lookup.test.js.
title: ID lookup: ranking, hash pick, embed/theme round-trip, empty state, no outbound side effects

testCases.description: rankLookupRows ranks an exact id match first, a prefix match second and a contains match third; the first ranked row is pre-highlighted in the LookupModal shell.
rankLookupRows ranks a word match in the title above a word match in the snippet when the id does not match; every query word must match title or snippet.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::rankLookupRows: a title match ranks above a snippet-only match (AC-205-2)

testCases.description: rankLookupRows with a one-character query returns only id matches; the title / snippet word-match pass is skipped.
wireLookup pick writes `#tab=<tab>&entity=<id>` through writeHash; the Router activates the tab, opens every ancestor DocRow and the entity, scrolls into view and flashes the target.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::page-init.js carries the wireLookup contract: Cmd/Ctrl+F binding, lazy fetch, up/down/Enter/Esc

testCases.description: A mount URL of `?tab=requirements&entity=US-304` lands on the same position at first paint via the Router (PR 1 contract), independent of the LookupModal.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::page-init.js urlWithHash preserves ?tab=&entity= + any other query at mount (AC-205-5)

testCases.description: A pick with `?embed=1&theme=dark` on the URL leaves both query params in place; only the hash fragment changes. Verified against writeHash + the hash-preservation helpers.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::page-init.js writeHash preserves ?embed= and ?theme= through every pick (AC-205-6)

testCases.description: A non-2xx / malformed `./index.json` response renders the empty state (The index could not be loaded.) with a visible Reload index button; no result rows show; the reload affordance re-fetches on click.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::renderLookupModal carries the empty-state + reload affordance markers (AC-205-7)

testCases.description: wireLookup never calls window.postMessage, never writes to localStorage / sessionStorage / document.cookie, and makes no outbound fetch other than `./index.json`; asserted by a source-level scan of page-init.js (no postMessage, no storage, no cookie writes in wireLookup).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/id-lookup.test.js::page-init.js does not add outbound postMessage, localStorage, sessionStorage or cookies in the lookup wiring (AC-205-8)

testCases.description: The WCAG 2.1 AA contrast audit (test/view/contrast-aa.test.js) requires a `.rcf-search-btn` pair for each of hover, focus-visible and active (state rules merged over the base rule) in both the light and dark token sets and asserts >= 4.5:1 for the button text and >= 3:1 for the focus ring against the surface it sits on. A missing state pair fails the test (PR 291 landing review F3).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/contrast-aa.test.js::.rcf-search-btn passes WCAG 2.1 AA in both themes across every state (AC-205-9)
